Streaming chat completion where the assistant responds with a tool call across multiple chunks

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _req_z = try std.heap.c_allocator.dupeSentinel(u8, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in NYC?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city and state, e.g. New York, NY\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}", 0);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_req_z);
    const _req_handle = liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_request_from_json(_req_z.ptr);
    if (_req_handle == 0) return error.RequestConversionFailed;
    defer liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_request_free(_req_handle);
    const _stream_handle = liter_llm.c.literllm_default_client_chat_stream_start(_client._handle, _req_handle);
    if (_stream_handle == 0) return error.StreamStartFailed;
    defer liter_llm.c.literllm_default_client_chat_stream_free(_stream_handle);
    while (true) {
        const _chunk = liter_llm.c.literllm_default_client_chat_stream_next(_stream_handle);
        if (_chunk == 0) {
            if (liter_llm.c.literllm_last_error_code() != 0) return error.StreamReadFailed;
            break;
        }
        defer liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_chunk_free(_chunk);
        const _json = liter_llm.c.literllm_chat_completion_chunk_to_json(_chunk);
        if (_json == null) return error.ChunkSerializationFailed;
        defer liter_llm.c.literllm_free_string(_json);
        std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{std.mem.span(_json)});
    }
}
```
